verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents a scriptable Editor API for programmatic scene manipulation and asset management, plus an official MCP server that lets AI agents modify project data in an open Editor session and verify the result. The docs explicitly direct users to change scenes from code with the Editor API or from an agent with the MCP server, and a probe confirmed the npm-published MCP package and its official repo. missing for 10: evidence that builds or publishes can be triggered programmatically (the REST API appears only as a bare plan-page line item), and detailed docs on creating entities and editing specific properties.
